name: capabilities
intro: The capabilities a role grants in OpenCRQ, as the role editors name them. A tenant role grants its capabilities in its tenant only; a platform role grants the platform's. A capability reaches a person through a group: a group holds roles, and a user or a service account belongs to groups. The first administrator gets an **Admin** role and group with every platform capability, and each new tenant an **Admin** role and group with every tenant capability.

sections.title: Tenant capabilities
sections.text: Granted by the roles of a tenant (the tenant's **Settings > Security > Roles**).

cells: Manage users, groups, roles and their capabilities.

sections.title: Platform capabilities
sections.text: Granted by the roles of the platform (the platform's **Settings > Security > Roles**).

cells: Access to the platform administration section.
